evidence.summary: States that 2024 began with a return to volatility, with the VIX rising by +10% in the first few hours of trading, indicating an early upward trend in January.

evidence.title: Where to next for the FTSE 100 and SP 500? | IG Bank Switzerland
evidence.summary: Mentions that the VIX dipped to its lowest level since January 2020 recently, suggesting a low starting point for volatility at the end of 2023, which could lead to a significant percentage increase if volatility rises in January.

evidence.title: Trading at the Cusp of a New Year – 2024 – Four Dimension Trading
evidence.summary: Discusses VIX topping signals and their relationship to SPX peaks, noting that the VIX made a new low on 12/12/23 and that a VIX topping signal was more likely around 01/18/24, implying a potential rise in VIX leading up to that date.

evidence.title: U.S. election worries show up in newly listed volatility futures - The Globe and Mail
evidence.summary: Highlights heightened expectations for stock market gyrations around the 2024 presidential election, with October VIX futures showing a significant premium. While focused on later in the year, this indicates an underlying sentiment of increasing volatility expectations for 2024, which could influence early-year VIX movements.

evidence.title: CBOE Google VIX Annualized Standard Deviation of Monthly Returns (Since Inception) Trends | YCharts
evidence.summary: Provides historical monthly data points for VIX-related metrics, including for January 2024, which can be used to understand the magnitude of VIX changes over time.

evidence.title: Over the past two decades, the S&P 500 Index has been unchanged, on average, in January with results equally split between gains and losses.
evidence.summary: Suggests that the S&P 500 has historically been relatively flat in January. While not directly about VIX, a stable S&P 500 might imply less extreme VIX movements, acting as a potential counter to significant VIX increases.

evidence.title: Will January 2024 Be a Good Month for U.S. Stocks?
evidence.summary: Discusses the outlook for U.S. stocks in January 2024. Positive stock performance often correlates with lower VIX, while negative performance can lead to higher VIX. This provides context for potential VIX behavior.
